consensus_rules: stage3_ensemble_rule.md (3/3 strong TP, 2/3 TP, 1/3 uncertain, 0/3 clean)

results.title: WebView setAllowFileAccess(true) — defender hardening only
results.rationale_merged: Defender flags missing hardening (default false on API 30+). Attacker chain blocked because callers (HtmlPopupScreenKt, ReleaseNotesKt) are internal Compose screens with no manifest deep-link. Domain expert sees no clear vehicle-asset impact under current caller graph. → uncertain.

attack_chain: external app → deep-link to HtmlPopup/ReleaseNotes (none registered)
blocked

results.title: WebView.loadUrl(htmlContentPath) — defender only
results.rationale_merged: Same caller chain as vc-1. Attacker has no exploitable producer; defender flags missing scheme allow-list; domain expert sees no vehicle impact. → uncertain.

results.title: grantRuntimePermission(packageName) caller-driven — internal Nav arg
results.rationale_merged: Defender flags absence of allow-list/signature gate. Attacker chain blocked: ApplicationDetailsViewModel.packageName comes from SavedStateHandle (Navigation arg) without a registered deep-link. Domain expert: HIGH IF caller becomes external (e.g. future deep-link); currently uncertain.

attacker.verdict: no external producer of packageName visible

defender.missing_control: signature permission on the entry route + explicit allow-list of target packages

results.title: revokeRuntimePermission(packageName) — symmetric to vc-3
results.rationale_merged: Same caller chain as vc-3. Symmetric verdict.

results.title: Implicit broadcast leaks Gleo response payload — confirmed external chain via IntentRouter
results.rationale_merged: Attacker chain confirmed: external app sends 'NAVIGATE_TO_SETTING' to VehicleControlActivity (exported=true) → IntentRouter forwards to respondAction → implicit broadcast. Defender flags missing setPackage/signature-permission. Domain expert maps to Information Disclosure of voice-assistant context (Gleo). All 3 perspectives agree — strong TP. Severity stays MEDIUM until response payload provably contains user data.

attack_chain: external app sends Intent action 'ai.umos.vehiclecontrol.NAVIGATE_TO_SETTING' to VehicleControlActivity (exported)
IntentRouter.toNavigationEvent invokes gleoActionSender.respondAction
external app's BroadcastReceiver registered for 'APP_ACTION_RESPONSE' observes status/message/response

defender.missing_control: Intent.setPackage(<pleos-package>) OR <permission> attribute on the receiver allow-list

results.title: Exported receiver persists untrusted macAddress to paired-device DB
results.rationale_merged: Manifest confirms <receiver android:exported="true"> with no permission. Attacker injects arbitrary macAddress → DB row under system-adjacent context. Defender: missing format validation + signature permission. Domain expert: Bluetooth pairing tampering — Spoofing/Tampering of paired-device identity, operational impact (e.g. spoofed Android Auto device). 3/3 strong TP. Severity raised to HIGH.

attack_chain: external app sends VehicleBroadcastIntent.DEVICE_SUPPORT_ANDROID_AUTO_WIRELESS broadcast with arbitrary macAddress
VehicleBroadcastReceiver persists to PairedDeviceRepository
spoofed device appears as paired Android Auto

defender.missing_control: MAC address format regex + android:permission='android.permission.BLUETOOTH_PRIVILEGED' on the <receiver>

domain_expert.vehicle_asset: 페어링된 디바이스 (Android Auto, 키레스 엔트리 등)

results.title: registerReceiver flag suppression — defender hardening only
results.rationale_merged: Defender: explicit RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED required on API 34+. Attacker has no specific chain because callers are diverse. Domain expert: no vehicle-specific impact. → uncertain.

defender.missing_control: Context.RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED flag explicit at every Broadcasts.observe(...) call site

results.title: Deterministic ECC key derivation from BuildConfig.IDENTIFIER — same key on every device
results.rationale_merged: Stage 2 caller trace resolved the passphrase: it is BuildConfig.IDENTIFIER (a build-time constant baked into the APK). Combined with single-SHA-256 KDF, every device derives the SAME ECC private key. Attacker recovers the constant by APK reverse engineering. Defender confirms missing PBKDF/salt/iterations. Domain expert: this key is used to decrypt the PleOS sync config (server endpoints, credentials) — recovering it gives every attacker the same access to the encrypted YAML config of every device. 3/3 strong TP, severity HIGH.

attack_chain: unzip the APK and read BuildConfig.IDENTIFIER + BuildConfig.SERVER_PUBLIC_KEY (constants)
run ECCCrypto.generateDeterministicPrivateKey(BuildConfig.IDENTIFIER) → identical private key to every device
ECDH with server public key + AES-GCM decrypt of any captured encryptedYaml config blob

defender.missing_control: (a) per-device salt + PBKDF2/Argon2 high-iteration; (b) Android Keystore EC key generation per device; (c) avoid build-time constant as a key seed entirely

results.title: Kotlin data-class toString embeds access token — log emission CONFIRMED at SysLogService:170
results.rationale_merged: Stage 2 grep confirms `Log.d(TAG, "onTokenChange : " + this.$authData)` at SysLogService:170. Token now provably reaches logcat under normal operation (every token rotation event). Attacker chain confirmed (logcat read via adb / dumpsys / privileged service). Defender + domain expert already HIGH. 3/3 strong TP.

attack_chain: app naturally writes Log.d(TAG, 'onTokenChange : ' + authData) per token rotation (SysLogService:170)
logcat reader (READ_LOGS, dumpsys, vendor diagnostic) captures the line
extract authenticatorToken substring → use as Bearer for connect-gw.umos.ai

defender.missing_control: override toString() to mask token; OR move token to a non-data-class wrapper; OR add ProGuard rule to strip toString in release; OR use Timber's .tag().mo... wrapper that filters sensitive fields

results.title: Hardcoded prod endpoint + credential POST — no pinning anywhere in ai/pleos/sync
results.rationale_merged: Stage 2 grep across `ai/pleos/sync/**` confirms NO `CertificatePinner` / `TrustManager` / `HostnameVerifier` / `network_security_config` in the sync code. Combined with the hardcoded HTTPS endpoint and credential POST, a CA-trusted MITM (corporate proxy with planted root, hostile Wi-Fi user-cert) reads `client_id` and `secret` in cleartext. CAVEAT: third-party HTTP client libraries (OkHttp/Retrofit/gRPC) bundled in the APK might still apply pinning; that grep is the next verification (PROVISIONAL strong TP).

attack_chain: plant CA-trusted root cert on the device or on intermediate proxy
intercept TLS to connect-gw-coral.umos.ai/auth/client/login
harvest {client_id, secret} JSON body
use credentials to obtain server-side tokens

defender.missing_control: OkHttpClient.Builder().certificatePinner(CertificatePinner) on the shared HttpClient and/or res/xml/network_security_config.xml with <pin-set>

per_perspective.caveat: third-party HttpClient/gRPC layer pinning는 sync/* 외부 패키지 (com.squareup.okhttp3 등) 추가 grep 필요

results.title: Exported provider returns LLM system-prompt corpus to any caller — 3/3 consensus
results.rationale_merged: Attacker constructs a one-shot read with content://ai.pleos.playground.llm.model.provider.prompts/ → receives full prompts.json. Defender: missing signature permission. Domain expert: jailbreak primitive on the in-vehicle voice-assistant brain — direct safety relevance. 3/3 unanimous, strong TP. Severity HIGH.

attack_chain: any installed app calls getContentResolver().query(content://ai.pleos.playground.llm.model.provider.prompts/...)
receives prompts.json verbatim
uses exact phrasing for prompt injection / jailbreak against Gleo

defender.missing_control: android:permission='ai.pleos.caas.EVENT_PERMISSION' (signature) on <provider>; or remove exported=true and use FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION on demand

domain_expert.vehicle_asset: LLM 시스템 프롬프트 (Gleo 안전 가드 + 명령 매핑)

results.title: Exported receiver enables LLM-model file deletion + process kill via custom actions — 3/3
results.rationale_merged: Attacker: external broadcast of FILE_SHARE_COMPLETE deletes the GGUF model file (persistent DoS via LLM_MODEL_SHARE_COMPLETE flag) + both actions kill the process. Defender: missing signature permission. Domain expert: DoS against on-device voice assistant. 3/3 unanimous, strong TP.

attack_chain: external app sends ai.pleos.llm.model.provider.intent.action.SHARE_FILE_COMPLETE broadcast
deleteLLMModelFile() removes the GGUF model in getFilesDir()
PreferenceHelper sets LLM_MODEL_SHARE_COMPLETE=true → subsequent BOOT paths skip re-shipping the model (persistent)

defender.missing_control: android:permission='ai.pleos.caas.EVENT_PERMISSION' (signature) attached to <receiver>; or move actions to a runtime-registered Context.RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED listener

results.title: HmgUserInfo PII (UUID/생년월일/이메일/이름) toString 누출 — emission 미확인
results.rationale_merged: Defender + domain expert: PII auto-toString 패턴 + 차량 도메인에서 운전자 신원 직접 노출 = HIGH (GDPR/개인정보보호법 적용). Attacker abstain: B-3.c grep 결과 (Timber|Log.[diwev]) + HmgUserInfo 매치 0건 — emission 미확인이라 실 exploit chain 불완전. 2/3 TP.

attacker.verdict: leak primitive real but no actual log emission of HmgUserInfo found in caller grep

defender.missing_control: override toString to mask PII (UUID=***, email=***@..., birthdate=***); or move PII fields out of data class

results.title: BuildConfig.IDENTIFIER as KDF passphrase — same root cause as ssl-1, listed as separate finding by hardcoded category
results.rationale_merged: attacker + defender + domain_expert 모두 동의: build-time 박힌 IDENTIFIER → 모든 device 동일 ECC 키 → 모든 device의 sync config 복호화. ssl-1 (KDF 설계)과 ssl-5 (passphrase가 hardcoded) 는 같은 attack chain의 두 layer. 3/3 strong TP, severity HIGH.

attack_chain: unzip APK → BuildConfig.IDENTIFIER 추출
ECCCrypto.generateDeterministicPrivateKey → 동일 ECC 키
ECDH(server_public_key) → AES-GCM decrypt of any encryptedYaml config

defender.missing_control: build-time 상수 대신 (a) 디바이스 unique salt + Android Keystore 또는 (b) 서버에서 device 별 발급 + secure provisioning

results.title: 차량 syslog가 평문 gRPC로 외부 송출 — ManagedChannelBuilder.usePlaintext() 명시
results.rationale_merged: B-3.c 추가 grep으로 SysLogService:76에서 .usePlaintext() 명시적 호출 confirmed. TLS 비활성화 → MITM이 차량 syslog (systemID + 로그 페이로드) 평문 관찰. logcat에 systemID + crp-analytics endpoint 노출(line 120)과 결합 시 영향 큼. attacker + defender + domain_expert 모두 HIGH 동의. 3/3 strong TP, severity HIGH로 격상.

attack_chain: passive MITM at the network path to BuildConfig.LOGCAT_PROXY_SERVER_URL (corporate proxy / hostile Wi-Fi / network tap)
observe gRPC frames in cleartext
extract systemID + log payload (vehicle telemetry, package state)

defender.missing_control: ManagedChannelBuilder.useTransportSecurity() (TLS) + CertificatePinner. Or migrate to OkHttpChannelBuilder.useTransportSecurity. Avoid usePlaintext() in production.

results.title: UnCrackable-Level1 hardcoded AES key + ciphertext (canonical MASVS-CRYPTO-1) — 3/3 strong TP
results.rationale_merged: All three perspectives confirm. Attacker: APK 추출 후 즉시 hex/base64 literal 추출 → AES 복호 → secret string 'I want to believe' 복원 (canonical OWASP challenge solution). Defender: KDF 도입 + per-session ephemeral key 도입 권고 — 즉시 fix 필요. Domain expert: MASVS-CRYPTO-1 + MASVS-STORAGE-2 직접 위반, OWASP MASTG의 leading example.

attacker.verdict: trivially exploitable — public OWASP solution exists
attack_chain: jadx decompile
extract hex literal (key) + base64 literal (ciphertext)
AES-ECB decrypt locally
recovered secret = compare target string

defender.missing_control: no KDF, no per-session secret. Mitigation: server-issued ephemeral verification token + per-session salt

domain_expert.vehicle_asset: 사용자 자격증명 (challenge demo, but pattern applies to IVI auth/keystore)

results.title: AES default mode (Cipher.getInstance("AES") = ECB without IV) — 3/3 strong TP
results.rationale_merged: All three perspectives agree on MEDIUM severity. Attacker: deterministic ECB enables pattern leakage chosen-plaintext analysis (in this challenge, paired with ucl1-1 the attack is via key recovery, but ECB alone is pre-conditional weakness). Defender: explicit Cipher.getInstance("AES/GCM/NoPadding") + per-message IV. Domain expert: MASVS-CRYPTO-1 — algorithm choice control violation, AES/ECB is industry-deprecated for arbitrary plaintext.

attacker.verdict: deterministic + no IV → pattern leakage; in this challenge subordinate to ucl1-1 key recovery

defender.missing_control: Cipher.getInstance with explicit GCM mode + IvParameterSpec

results.title: Crypto exception detail logged via Log.d — 2/3 TP (attacker abstain, hardening only)
results.rationale_merged: Attacker abstains: in production builds Log.d is typically stripped, and even on debuggable build the CodeCheck error message reveals nothing the attacker doesn't already know post-key-extraction. Defender flags as hardening (production builds must filter logs, vendor diagnostics may readback). Domain expert flags MASVS-STORAGE-3 (sensitive data not leaked via system logs) — tertiary control.

attacker.verdict: abstain — minimal exploit value beyond ucl1-1

defender.missing_control: production build filter / Timber.tag with debug guard / no PII or crypto state in logs

results.title: UnCrackable-Level3 hardcoded XOR key (init param to libfoo.so) — 3/3 strong TP
results.rationale_merged: All three perspectives confirm. Attacker: 24-byte XOR key는 string literal로 APK에 박혀 있고, native init(xorkey.getBytes())로 전달된다. APK 추출 후 즉시 키 노출 — 굳이 native lib 분해할 필요 없이 ucl3-1만으로 hardcoded secret 위반 명확. Defender: per-session ephemeral key + server-issued challenge 도입 권고. Domain expert: MASVS-CRYPTO-1 / MASVS-STORAGE-2 위반 — Level1과 같은 패턴이지만 native와 결합되어 더 깊은 anti-tamper 환경.

attacker.verdict: trivially extractable from APK string pool
attack_chain: jadx decompile
extract MainActivity.xorkey literal
use as XOR key against (native-derived) ciphertext

defender.missing_control: no per-session secret. Mitigation: server-issued ephemeral challenge + OS Keystore

consensus_distribution_after_stage2_b3c.note: Phase B-3.c follow-up resolved 3 escalations: ssl-1 (passphrase = BuildConfig.IDENTIFIER 확인), ssl-2 (Log.d emission at SysLogService:170 확인), ssl-3 (sync 패키지 내 SSL 코드 부재 확인 — third-party lib pinning은 추가 검증 필요로 'provisional')

strong_TP_provisional: ssl-3 CCGAuthenticator pinning (sync 패키지 confirmed; third-party lib 추가 검증 필요)

new_findings_discovered_during_b3c.title: Driver PII (UUID/birthdate/email/name) leaked via Kotlin data-class toString() — same pattern as ssl-2 but for personally identifying info
BuildConfig.IDENTIFIER used as KDF passphrase = effectively a hardcoded secret in the APK
gRPC endpoint connect-gw.umos.ai:9091 — TLS verdict depends on grpc-channel SSL config (verification pending)

comparison_with_self_GT_after_b3c.self_GT_TP_after_b3c_escalation: 8 (ssl-1, ssl-3 also flipped from uncertain to TP based on attacker confirmation; ssl-2 was already TP)
comparison_with_self_GT_after_b3c.agreement_on_self_GT_TP: all 8 self-GT TPs reached 3/3 consensus (or provisional 3/3 in ssl-3 case)
comparison_with_self_GT_after_b3c.interpretation: After Phase B-3.c caller resolution, every self-GT TP reaches strong TP in stage 3, and every self-GT FP stays in uncertain (defender-only). Consensus rule maps cleanly to ground-truth labels.

stage3_metric_impact_vs_stage1_after_b3c.caveat: 표본 n=12 단일 APK 세트. OWASP MASTG 도입 후 외부 GT 기반 재측정 필수. ssl-3는 third-party lib pinning 추가 검증 후 strong TP 확정 가능.

consensus_distribution_after_b3c_full.note: After full B-3.c follow-up (pinning grep + emission grep): ssl-3 confirmed 3/3 (no longer provisional), ssl-4 added as 2/3 (PII leak primitive without confirmed emission), ssl-5 added as 3/3 (separate hardcoded finding from ssl-1), ssl-6 added as 3/3 HIGH (usePlaintext() confirmed)

consensus_distribution_after_combined_n1.note: 2026-04-30: ucl1-1 (hardcoded AES key, 3/3) + ucl1-2 (AES/ECB mode, 3/3) + ucl1-3 (Log.d hardening, 2/3) 추가. 11 strong TP = vc-5/6 + lmp-1/2 + ssl-1/2/3/5/6 + ucl1-1/2. 2 TP at ≥2/3 = ssl-4 (PII), ucl1-3 (log hardening). 5 uncertain = vc-1/2/3/4/7 (모두 self-GT FP 또는 LOW).
2026-04-30 (extension): ucl3-1 (XOR key, 3/3) 추가로 strong TP 11→12. 2/3 TP 변동 없음 (ssl-4 + ucl1-3 그대로). uncertain 5건 (vc-1/2/3/4/7) 변동 없음.
